title: Utils
description: Coroutine utilities for debouncing, throttling, and Flow helpers.

pages.title: Debouncer
pages.summary: Delays forwarding values until no new values have arrived for a given delay.

api.name: Debouncer
api.signature: class Debouncer<T>(scope: CoroutineScope, delay: Duration = 300.milliseconds, leading: Boolean = false)
api.summary: Coroutine-based debouncer with trailing-edge (default) and optional leading-edge semantics.

params.name: scope
params.description: Scope that owns the internal job.

params.name: delay
params.description: Quiet period before a value is forwarded.

params.name: leading
params.description: If true, emit immediately then suppress for the delay window.

api.name: KDebounce
api.signature: fun <T> KDebounce(scope: CoroutineScope, delay: Duration = 300.milliseconds, leading: Boolean = false, block: suspend (T) -> Unit): KDebouncer<T>
api.summary: Factory helper that creates a debouncer and registers a suspending callback.

pages.title: Throttler
pages.summary: Forwards at most one value per period (leading-edge).

api.name: Throttler
api.summary: Coroutine-based throttler that drops values inside the same period window.

api.name: KThrottle
api.signature: fun <T> KThrottle(scope: CoroutineScope, period: Duration = 500.milliseconds, block: suspend (T) -> Unit): KThrottler<T>
api.summary: Factory helper that creates a throttler and registers a suspending callback.

examples.code:
private val clickThrottler = KThrottle(viewModelScope, 500.milliseconds) { handleClick() }

KButton(text = "Click", onClick = { clickThrottler.emit(Unit) })

pages.title: Flow extensions
pages.summary: Leading-edge debounce and throttle-first helpers for any Flow.

api.name: kDebounceLeading
api.summary: Emits the first item in a burst immediately, then suppresses further items until the duration elapses.

api.name: kThrottleFirst
api.summary: Throttles a Flow to emit at most one item per period (leading edge).
